tools.name: kelify_create_conversation
tools.description: Create a new conversation session for property search. Each conversation maintains context across multiple messages, allowing for natural follow-up questions.

tools.name: kelify_send_message
tools.description: Send a user message to a conversation and receive an AI response with property search results. Can use streaming or non-streaming mode.

conversation_id.description: The conversation UUID to send the message to

message.description: The user's message to the AI assistant for property search

stream.description: Whether to stream the response. Default is true.

tools.name: kelify_get_conversation
tools.description: Retrieve full conversation history including all messages, AI responses, search results, and usage statistics.
